credit.title: Eiger, Mönch und Jungfrau - Panorama.jpg
credit.author: Barbara Steinemann
credit.why: Eiger, Moench and Jungfrau with snow confined to the summits and green meadows below - early-September conditions. The dark conifers along the bottom are where the title scrim sits.

credit.title: The Circle, tunnel at Zurich Airport.jpg
credit.author: Olga Ernst
credit.why: The actual covered walkway from the terminal to The Circle, where the Radisson Blu is. Biased to keep both the wayfinding sign and the whole tunnel arch.

credit.title: Altstadt Zürich 2015.jpg
credit.author: Thomas Wolf , www.foto-tw.de
credit.why: Zurich's old town along the Limmat, CC BY-SA 3.0 de. The rest day is spent here on foot, which is the whole point of it.

credit.title: Lake Lungern, Obwalden.jpg
credit.author: Oleg.o.lyamin
credit.why: Lungerersee from the old Bruenigstrasse above the shore, looking down the valley: the turquoise water, the village on the bank and a snow-capped summit beyond. The day is now named after this stop, and this is the view the tip about the bypass tunnel is telling you not to miss. Biased up to keep the peak.

credit.title: Eiger, Mönch und Jungfrau.jpg
credit.author: Steinmann
credit.why: The Maennlichen ridge with the gravel path curving away and the three summits behind - the Panorama Trail as it is actually walked.

credit.title: CH.BE.Grindelwald 2021-04-20 Jungfraujoch Sphinx-Observatory.jpg
credit.author: NOTE: This image is a panorama of Jungfraujoch Sphinx-Observatory consisting of 5 frames that were merged or stitched in PTGui Pro 12.2. As a result, this image necessarily underwent some form of digital manipulation. These manipulations may include blending, blurring, cloning, and colour and perspective adjustments. As a result of these adjustments, the image content may be slightly different from reality at the points where multiple images were combined. This manipulation is often required due to lens, perspective, and parallax distortions.
credit.why: The Sphinx observatory itself, the one structure that says Top of Europe. Biased up so the dome and mast survive the band.

credit.title: Lauterbrunnen view from Mürren.jpg
credit.author: Deralpinbergsteiger
credit.why: The Lauterbrunnen valley seen from high on the Muerren side, waterfall streaks down the far wall.

credit.title: Aareschlucht 166 7.jpg
credit.author: Pazit Polak
credit.why: Inside the Aare gorge: walls leaning together, sunlit foliage overhanging, the river below.

credit.title: 20240906.Vitznau–Rigi-Bahn.-026.jpg
credit.author: Bybbisch94
credit.why: Rigi above the sea of fog with the Alps beyond, photographed on 6 September - the same date the family will be up there.

credit.title: Luzern Wasserturm Kapellbrücke-20130829-RM-104703.jpg
credit.author: Reinhold Möller Ermell
credit.why: Overrides the picker's blue-hour frame, which is beautiful but has snow on the bridge and the rooftops. This one is late August: green, flowers on the Kapellbruecke, swans on the Reuss. Biased up so the Wasserturm keeps its spire.

credit.title: Cloudy Alps from above (Unsplash).jpg
credit.author: Anastasia Zhenina disguise_truth
credit.why: The Alps from a cabin window on the way home, CC0. Overrides the picker's Swissair press photo: 1980s film of an airline that folded in 2002, and effectively airline advertising.
